purpose: Produce a conventional parent-DFT band diagram for the working Ragasa2026icmsep manuscript without substituting the 408-point valley/Hessian inventory for a band path.
expected_outputs: QEXSD data-file-schema.xml with 241 ordered points and 20 eigenvalues per point
parent DFT band figure and machine-readable plotted data

anticipated_resources.runtime: minutes on one local process; not known prospectively more precisely
anticipated_resources.external_storage: an isolated copy of the 6.6 MB SCF state plus calculator outputs; disk_io='none' suppresses new path wavefunction files
anticipated_resources.repository_retention: compact inputs, QEXSD, streams, checksums, plotted data, and figures only

claim_boundary: This is a parent PBE Kohn-Sham band path for context and source-adequacy comparison. It is not an experimental spectrum, a quasiparticle calculation, a convergence study, or publication qualification by itself.
